method: Replay only recorded ordinary commands from actual UI-exported cycle20 to actual UI-exported postsettlement29. Missing/misnamed annotations resolved from clicked control/selection; all normalization documented. No grants, direct state edits, or fabricated pre-accept save. Diagnostic willingness score is recomputed from the inspected formula and lawful Khar local observations; engine exports unchanged.
preAcceptSource: Verified replay checkpoint, not an untouched original export

playerForecast.policy: Khar frontier rivalry: a shared border increases its grievances by 1 each peaceful cycle. At 24 grievances, a sufficiently strong Khar force may cancel trade with notice and prepare for war.

war.effect: Declare war: mutual trust −40; the other empire gains 20 grievance. War opens their borders.

peace.effect: Pay 60 credits to end the war. War is forbidden for 5 cycles. Fleets in each other’s territory withdraw to their nearest owned colony, or a charted neutral system if they have no colony. A fleet with neither destination remains in place with no moves.

willingness.reason: Their colonies face military pressure they can observe.
reasons: Their colonies face military pressure they can observe.
The Khar Dominion is reluctant to concede a war.

trade.reason: End the war before negotiating trade.
trade.effect: Open borders and earn 6 credits per turn, or 10 with Stellar Accords. Mutual trust +10. Border grievances can still cause cancellation.

gift.reason: Diplomatic gifts cannot be sent during war.
gift.effect: Transfer 35 credits; mutual trust +20. Existing border grievances remain.

endTrade.effect: Give 3 cycles of notice. Income and access continue until turn 31, then both end and visiting fleets withdraw. Mutual trust −5; the other empire gains 5 grievance.

acceptPeace.effect: Receive 60 credits. End the war and establish a 5-cycle truce. Fleets in each other’s territory withdraw to their nearest owned colony, or a charted neutral system if they have no colony. A fleet with neither destination remains in place with no moves.

declinePeace.effect: Continue the war without moving any fleet. The proposer receives its reserved credits back.
